environmentVariables.name: ST_LLM_PROVIDER
environmentVariables.description: Set to 'openai_compatible' to enable the hosted LLM fallback tier. Leave as 'mock' (default) for the zero-dependency prototype.

environmentVariables.name: ST_LLM_API_KEY

environmentVariables.description: Keep 'true' (default) while the Alipay AI-收 integration is not live in production.
